system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Searches for pesticide and seed dealers in a specified location. For your information, my location is dummy_location_4468.

function.name: dealer_get_details
function.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific dealer including name, address, contact, products carried, and license status. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT verify license — use dealer_verify_license. Data may be stale or contain inconsistencies. Fails if dealer_id invalid.

function.name: dealer_search_by_location
function.description: Searches for pesticide and seed dealers in a specified location. Location (village/district/state) is MANDATORY. Returns dealer names, addresses, and basic info. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT verify dealer license or check inventory. Queries without valid location are INVALID. Fails if location invalid or no dealers found in the area.
